problem_text:
A regional courier must dispatch a vehicle to collect documents from five different branch offices scattered across a metropolitan area.

The travel times between offices are as follows:
* Office Alpha to Beta: 116.1 minutes
* Office Alpha to Gamma: 121.5 minutes
* Office Alpha to Delta: 78.9 minutes
* Office Alpha to Epsilon: 128.7 minutes
* Office Beta to Gamma: 183.6 minutes
* Office Beta to Delta: 179.1 minutes
* Office Beta to Epsilon: 22.0 minutes
* Office Gamma to Delta: 67.9 minutes
* Office Gamma to Epsilon: 181.0 minutes
* Office Delta to Epsilon: 184.8 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient circuit that allows the courier to arrive at each branch precisely once before concluding the collection run back at the initial office.
